title: AI Skill That Will Replace 80% of Office Jobs
full_monologue: **This AI skill is coming for your job.** It’s not coding or data entry—it’s natural language processing. AI can now write emails, draft reports, and even negotiate deals. Think about it: if an AI can mimic human communication perfectly, why would companies hire humans for routine tasks? The future of work is here, and it’s faster than you think. What will you do when AI takes over your job? Comment below.
